title: Migrate Prospectus-web (pr.ospect.us) onto the standard front end

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done and live. Prospectus-web PR #10 (merged): web/projection.json + web/css/site-theme.css + web/hooks.py replace build_via_papyrus.py, publication_shell.py and the CMS projector (-144 lines; +77 hooks, +41 build, +29 settings). Built with papyrus ops content project --all --from-dir (Papyrus 5.1.0; core PR #408). Canonical links fixed (/ instead of /index.html); sitemap.xml, robots Sitemap line and noindex 404 now served. Parity vs live, 41 URLs: 0 blocking (DOM identical on 8 pages). Deployed by the prospectus-marketing CodePipeline in cyclotron-production (682849160744), Source/Build/Deploy Succeeded; live check: all old URLs same status, canonical https://pr.ospect.us/, sitemap.xml 200, robots 200, unknown path 404.
